penjelasan.id: Ikuti petunjuk lokasi menuju lantai 2 Apotek Alpro. Pastikan jadwal melalui kontak resmi klinik sebelum datang.
penjelasan.en: Follow the directions to the second floor of Apotek Alpro. Confirm opening hours through an official clinic contact before visiting.

fitur_khas.alasan_dipilih: Alamat di direktori menyebut klinik berada di lantai 2 Apotek Alpro; petunjuk akses dapat membantu pasien baru.

a.id: Menurut direktori, Moridental berada di Jl. Raden Patah, Parung Serab, Ciledug, lantai 2 Apotek Alpro.
a.en: According to a public directory, Moridental is on Jl. Raden Patah in Parung Serab, Ciledug, on the second floor of Apotek Alpro.

q.en: Is the clinic open on Sundays?

a.id: Direktori mencantumkan buka setiap hari 09.00–21.00. Mohon konfirmasi jadwal sebelum datang.
a.en: A directory lists daily hours of 09:00–21:00. Please confirm before visiting.

q.en: How much do scaling and fillings cost?

a.id: Tarif resmi belum terverifikasi. Tanyakan perkiraan biaya setelah pemeriksaan.
a.en: Official fees have not been verified. Please ask the clinic for an estimate after an assessment.
